integrity: The count is derived symbolically from the strong nil-clean lifting criterion, primary decomposition, Gaussian-binomial complement count, and the classical exact count of nilpotent matrices over finite fields. Exhaustive computations are used only as consistency checks.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to the square-zero dual-number ring over finite fields. It does not count merely nil-clean elements for arbitrary q or address higher nilpotent thickenings. An older equivalent count hidden in finite-matrix cycle-index literature remains a residual originality risk.
title: Exact strongly nil-clean census over \(\mathbb F_q[\varepsilon]/(\varepsilon^2)\)
